answer.reason: The verses tell two things of Dathan beyond the summary: his refusal to come to Moses and his being swallowed by the earth.

clauses.english: refused to come when Moses called him, and accused Moses of making himself a prince
was swallowed up by the earth with his household and tents
clauses.quote: the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households

doubts: The summary's phrase 'rebelled against Moses with Korah' already covers the rebellion itself, so the clauses give only his refusal and his end.
NUM 16:31-33 were not given, so the swallowing rests on DEU 11:6 and NUM 26:10.
